job.name: ig14_host_b
job.meaning: женщина ~38, светлые прямые волосы до плеч, кремовый брючный костюм, сидит в чёрном кожаном кресле на сцене, красный бархатный занавес, микрофон на стойке
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of an elegant confident Russian woman about 38, straight sleek light-blonde shoulder-length hair, a cream tailored trouser suit with a black silk top, black pointed heels, thin gold necklace. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium-wide shot from the knees up, she sits in a black leather lounge armchair slightly turned to the camera with legs crossed, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, a black podcast microphone on a short stand near her face on the side (not covering the mouth), her face large enough and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm open gesture, confident warm expression, NO broad smile. Background: a stage with deep red velvet pleated curtains, soft spotlight from above, dark floor. Look: a real frame from a high-end interview show camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
